tools.description: Ultra-fast port scanner with Nmap integration for network discovery
tools.usage:
rustscan -a 192.168.1.1 # Scan all ports
rustscan -p 80,443,22 192.168.1.1 # Specific ports
rustscan --ulimit 5000 192.168.1.0/24 # High performance scan
rustscan -a target.com -- -sV # Nmap service detection
